selectionPolicy.editableFormat: JSON source-pixel polygons and inclusive row spans
selectionPolicy.cloudMotion: Only the complete detached east-wisp island moves. Continuous eastward drift at 0.55 native pixels/second uses integer x, fixed source y=39, the independently reviewed fixed cloudClip scanlines and offscreen-only wrap. All other clouds remain static. The coarse sky-plane polygon is not the cloud motion clip.
selectionPolicy.vegetationMotion: Full leaf clusters chosen as row spans; no colour threshold inside canopy cutouts.
selectionPolicy.hiddenPlate: Never used as a whole-scene replacement. Compare exposed donor at motion limits separately from the exact rest roundtrip.
selectionPolicy.npcOcclusion: Foreground plane is static and excludes moving foliage pixels through the local hidden plate. Runtime depth and paths require independent scene review.
selectionPolicy.windAmplitude: Runtime rounds source-pixel offsets then hard-clamps to ±1. Gains 1.2–1.5 keep small crowns visibly active; the earlier <=0.3 proposal was rejected because it quantized all motion to zero.
selectionPolicy.water: Exact selected source-water mask excludes the fir and green shoreline. Runtime rowSpans use end-exclusive bounds and are generated from the same alpha used by the water image.
selectionPolicy.localLightReceivers: R09-only explicit edits of pinned R08 binary white receiver masks. clearBounds removes an obsolete selected receiver only in the exported copy; reviewed rowSegments select actual glass or stone. No scene RGB is altered.
